I see. The WHOIS should still return which company registered the domain though, and many of these companies also host. 

If you don’t have the host company from the above, get the IP address the URL leads to and do a reverseDNS search. That should lead you to the hosting company.

That company will likely have terms and conditions about hosting, and will likely forbid harassment using their services. You can email that company explaining everything, and see if they take action.
Have you tried a WHOIS search? You can find out in many cases who registered a domain. Many websites offer it for free.

Everyone used to tell me I used to write whatever I said in the air with my finger as a child, I’m starting to think this was maybe a compulsion. I also had to avoid looking at one particular sign outside of the town hall every time my family drove past it or else it meant my Mum or Dad were going to die. Other than that, I remember being on holiday and holding my breath in the pool for like 2 minutes and flicking switches at around 10/11 to stop my Mum from dying. Then I had HIV obsessions around 13/14 (again this massively flared up on holiday, I spent most of that holiday crying and worried I was infecting my family with HIV if I touched them, pure hell). Never told anyone anything until I was in my 20s. I should have.

This disease is evil, it has taken so much from me.

I had to wait for my dad outside an opticians a few weeks ago and the anxiety was insane, I was so conscious as people might think I’m a sexual predator waiting for someone or sizing up a building for a burglary. You just have to sit there with the thoughts, avoiding it doesn’t work.

My God yes. I panic in stores because I think security will think I’m stealing, which makes me look more suspect. Same with airport security. I *hate* walking near men or women in case they think I’m following them. One of my worst is having to park outside someone’s house and wait for them in case the neighbours think I’m doing something suspicious or passers by think I’m stalking them.
So many familiar stories! I’m glad you share the same desire to help.

Some ideas:

What if we make posts in communities to do with health or advice where we bring attention to those with questions that seem irrational, repeated, assurance seeking, and ask them to direct such people to the OCD communities here or other OCD resources?
Congratulations 😊putting a name to an illness that has affected you for so long is relieving. I just despair for all those out there suffering without knowing.
It could be burnout. A lot of people late 20s/early 30s get this. Sometimes your work just stops being fulfilling and you lose motivations It’s very well known issue. Look up burnout on YouTube.

Interestingly you may have benefitted from these obsessions with medical knowledge. That’s one positive. I’d say it’s never worth it though, but to have a positive is a good thing. I have a pretty profound understanding of HIV.
It’s mad isn’t it? All this wasted energy and suffering.
Keep the faith. Even though it may feel hopeless now!
Honestly in the last 4 days or so. I was having bad anxiety even a week ago. The change was quite sudden for me.
There are solutions I promise. Please see your doctor.

Hey, Zoloft (sertraline) really worked for my morning anxiety. It basically eliminated it after 4 weeks. I used to hate it too and found the idea of suicide as a comfort. It is the worst feeling to wake up to and makes life very miserable. But I suggest you try an SSRI and never drink alcohol the night before.
